blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型在文本第一任务,如编码,数学,写作等方面表现出杰出的表现. 最近的努力正在转变模型的培训方式,以包括科学问题,这些问题往往生活在文字以外的高度专业化的领域,如蛋白质结构和生物图像。 然而,在这些假设中,它们与专门算法相比的普通用途准确性仍然存有疑问。 其中一个领域是细胞跟踪,这需要瞬间对细胞动力学的认识. 为了评价这一点,我们建立了一个新的基准,即CellTrack-Bench,它对照专门的跟踪者评估Visual-Language Models(VLM)的细胞跟踪相关性能. 整个基准取自15个标准细胞跟踪数据集,涉及四种成像模式,包含1 537个问题,相当于9 041个细胞链接决定。 我们选择了一个硬子集 需要更多的推理努力 通过识别失败 共享不同的算法跟踪器。 有了这个拟议的数据集,我们:(一) 评估了不同环境对VLM的利用;(二) 以9个前沿封闭源模型和13个开放加权模型为基准;(三) 详细分析了它们的故障模式。 编码、存储的模型输出以及从源数据集中重新生成基准的管道可在https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench查阅。

Cell tracking shares many similarities with Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) [ 12 ] in the traditional natural imaging domain, as both involve identifying and tracking objects.
They’re commonly solved through the paradigm of tracking-by-detection, where an algorithm segments or detects the objects and then links them over time.
However, cell tracking benefits from specialized
solutions [ 45 , 28 , 7 ] because
objects are almost identical, can be divided, and quickly undergo morphological
changes, unlike objects in natural images (e.g., cars, pedestrians).

Here, we take a different approach. Rather than dividing the problem from the algorithmic point of view, we view the operations in two different regimes: (i) a highly mechanical scenario
where it’s easy to design an algorithm to automatically link the objects, for
example, with optimal matching [ 21 , 13 ] ; and
(ii) a highly cognitive scenario where one must reason about what is happening
within the image, considering cell state, if undergoing division, if near the
boundary of the field of view, and many other experimental conditions, see Figure 1 for a practical example.

To validate this novel paradigm for cell tracking, we built CellTrack-Bench from
15 cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities. Thirteen datasets
contribute 1,537 problems, amounting to 9,041 linking instances.

blocks.en: For CellTrack-Bench, we define three tasks that progressively change the role of the VLM from directly constructing associations, to correcting an existing tracking solution, to identifying errors for review: (i) cell linking; (ii) track repair; and (iii) track inspection.
blocks.zh: 就CellTrack-Bench而言,我们界定了三项任务,这些任务逐步改变了VLM的作用,从直接构建协会,更正现有的跟踪解决方案,变为查明有待审查的错误:(一) 细胞连接;(二) 跟踪修复;(三) 跟踪检查。

blocks.en: In cell linking , the model directly predicts the correspondence between cells in two consecutive frames. In track repair , it is given a graph from an algorithmic tracker and has to determine the set of link corrections that will fix the graph. In track inspection , it detects the tracker decisions that need review, corresponding to a human-in-the-loop triage scenario. Taken together, these tasks highlight different aspects of tracking that the model can collectively cover the operations needed to correct tracking errors across a dataset.
blocks.zh: 在单元格链接中,该模型直接预测两个连续帧的单元格之间的对应关系. 在轨迹修补中,它从一个算法跟踪器得到一个图,必须确定将修补图的一组链接校正. 在田径检查中,它检测出需要审查的田径者决定,对应的是"人与人"的切分情景. 综合起来,这些任务突出了跟踪的不同方面,即模型可以共同涵盖纠正整个数据集的跟踪错误所需的操作。

We apply these three tasks to difficult cell tracking cases that are local rather than to complete time-lapse sequences. In a normal cell-tracking problem, an algorithm handles a complete time-lapse series of microscopy images; in our approach, each problem is concentrated on the more difficult cell links (see Figure 2 ). This is necessary
since, in most datasets having sufficient temporal resolution, cells do not
move much until a cell-state change takes place, at which point their visual
appearance may change and they can exhibit erratic movement and displacement.
Although such events are rare and more prone to error, the overall tracking
performance can mask them. We identify the difficult cases algorithmically by
looking at failures that are common to multiple trackers.

After having chosen the difficult cases and defined the tasks, assessing the VLMs also required controlling the way in which these problems are presented to the model. For this reason, we conducted a study looking at various environment strategies, recently known as harnesses , such as the method of presenting cells, the way in which coordinate information is given, the use of multi-turn settings, and visual hints like segmentation outlines.
For our
study we carried out a validation-only investigation into environmental changes
with respect to the VLM and kept the best-performing configuration for the test
evaluation. We also introduce proximity-debiased metrics which separately
assess associations that are not already accounted for by a nearest-neighbor
rule, together with division-specific and graph-level measures. Our protocol
also takes into account the composition of the dataset
and the output-token budget.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
With recent advancements in instance segmentation
models [ 41 , 18 , 40 ] ,
cell-tracking methods have almost exclusively relied on the
tracking-by-detection paradigm, focusing on association (edge) prediction, as
TrackMate [ 21 , 43 ] and
btrack [ 44 ] on the algorithmic side. On the deep learning
front, Trackastra [ 14 ] predicts pairwise cell
detection associations using a transformer over temporal windows, while
HOCT [ 8 ] models the higher-order cell-to-cell
interactions among the competing candidate links. The most widely regarded
benchmark is the Cell Tracking Challenge (CTC), which standardized performance
evaluation using lineage-aware graph-edit
metrics [ 45 , 28 ] and includes a hidden test
evaluated by the organizers. Our proposed benchmark uses a similar methodology,
assuming cell segmentation is given, and evaluating performance based on local
associations between consecutive frames.

Because even very effective trackers still produce a few mistakes,
human-in-the-loop review is often necessary. Pop et al. [ 37 ] framed
the verification as a multi-armed bandit problem. OrganoidTracker flags
suspicious links for review [ 23 ] . Meanwhile, its
successor, OrganoidTracker 2, computes probabilities for each
link [ 6 ] . These interactive approaches motivate our
track repair and track inspection tasks, in which a VLM serves as an external
assistant that either corrects or prioritizes links for revision. Because the
difficulty of tracking individual cells is heavily skewed towards easy cells,
existing metrics fail to assess the quality of hard instances; therefore,
CellTrack-Bench extends evaluation from tracker-specific metrics to a more
specific assessment of the model’s ability to link, repair, and inspect hard
instances across multiple trackers and imaging modalities.

blocks.en:
Shortcut-resistant and controlled evaluation. Benchmark performance might overestimate a model’s visual understanding if the
model makes use of linguistic or visual
shortcuts [ 15 , 10 ] . In cell tracking, the main
shortcut is spatial proximity: a nearest-neighbor rule accounts for much of the
association distribution. CellTrack-Bench therefore uses sequence-disjoint
validation/test splits, implements a ranked tracker-error mining, per-dataset
sampling caps, and uses debiased metrics with respect to proximity or division
events. VLM performance can also depend on how the problem is presented and the
models’ harness [ 48 ] . Therefore, the evaluation protocol includes
the renderer, the coordinate exploration interface, the prompt, and the
inference budget. We selected these components based on validation data and
kept them fixed during testing. The result is a controlled diagnostic benchmark
for VLM-assisted cell linking and track inspection, not a new tracker or training
method.

blocks.en: 3.6 Prompting and Harness Design
blocks.zh: 3.6 提示和利用设计

blocks.en:
As described above, a benchmark instance specifies the task, the candidate
graph, and the ground-truth graph, and their respective scene from the original
image data, but not the way in which this information is
presented to a VLM. As in previous work [ 48 ] , we call this harness the environment the models are subject to; it includes the image
rendering, the prompt template, the localization cues, the
available tools, the generation budget, the answer schema, and the parser. The
way these elements are chosen can have a significant effect on performance by
making cell localization and visual comparison easier or more difficult.

We look at eight conditions, as summarized in
Table 1 . Those were chosen considering different
ways that the model could operate. In each case, we use the same frames,
candidate graph, task instruction, answer schema, and scorer; the only
difference is the evidence interface. The conditions vary by whether the cells
are identified using normalized bounding boxes (text-based) or visual outlines
(image-based), whether
close-up crops are provided in advance or requested by the model, and whether
the global two-frame overview is available. They involve two main types of
interface: an evidence-supplied single-turn interface, which offers
annotated frames and pre-rendered cell crops, and an evidence-requested multi-turn interface, in which the model chooses the areas to examine using a crop_and_zoom tool. Condition c7 omits the global overview and is
considered merely as an information-loss ablation.
Appendix A.5 illustrates the two interface families and
all eight evidence presentations in Figures 4 and 5 , respectively.

type and per-neighborhood graph. Repair F1 measures how much of the proposed
graph is correct after editing, but not whether the model improves the graph.
For that, we rely on Δ \Delta LNK. GPT-5.6 (sol) is the most useful, raising LNK
by +0.412 and
improving 80% of the cases while worsening only 7% and 13% kept unchanged.
On the other hand, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B achieves a repair F1 of 0.622, but its LNK is
increased only by +0.008,

changing LNK by -0.099 and -0.385. Six of the 13 open-weight models actually

Can VLMs prioritize human review? Appendix Table 9 evaluates inspection under fixed review budgets.
Inspection is only useful if it identifies errors early enough to reduce human effort.
We therefore cap flags at a fixed review budget and simulate the correction of the selected sources.
Under the most restrictive budget, the frontier models
achieve a recovery of Δ \Delta LNK between +0.235 and +0.249, which is 83–88%
of the gold oracle’s +0.284 and almost twice that of a random reviewer

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced CellTrack-Bench, a benchmark for assessing vision-language models
(VLMs) for cell tracking by breaking long tracking sequences into compact,
digestible tasks for current models. Given the skewed distribution of mistakes,
we selected difficult associations from common mistakes made by specialized
trackers and formulated three complementary tasks: cell linking, track repair,
and track inspection. Our formulation lets us evaluate whether VLMs can
directly restore cell associations, fix existing tracking solutions, or
prioritize likely mistakes for review during human data curation.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了CellTrack-Bench,这是评估视觉语言模型的基准
(VLM)用于细胞跟踪,将长的跟踪序列分解为紧凑,
当前模型的可消化任务 。 鉴于错误的扭曲分布,
我们从专业犯的常见错误中选出了困难的社团
追踪器和拟订三项互补任务:细胞连接、轨道修复、
和跟踪检查。 我们的提法让我们来评估 虚拟LMs能否
直接恢复细胞关联,修正现有的跟踪解决方案,或
优先处理人类数据整理过程中可能出现的错误。

blocks.en:
Our results suggest that advanced VLMs possess abilities that go beyond mere
geometric tricks. The most advanced VLMs, the closed-source frontier models,
can operate without nearest-neighbor shortcuts, improve poorly performing
tracker solutions, and prioritize tracker errors even under limited inspection
budgets. However, these abilities are not universal: weaker models
still rely on the proximity shortcut and, in some cases, can even worsen
tracking performance during repair. Taken together, these facts suggest that,
for now, VLMs are better used as reasoning modules in the cell-tracking
pipeline rather than as substitutes for specialized trackers. We expect our
CellTrack-Bench to serve as an evaluation setting for developing VLMs capable of cognitive reasoning about complex biological events, where specialized trackers often make mistakes.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,先进的甚高压材料具有超越单纯的能力。
几何伎俩. 最先进的VLM,闭源前沿模型,
可以在没有近邻快捷键的情况下运行,改善性能差
跟踪器解决方案,并在有限的检查中确定跟踪器错误的优先次序
预算。 然而,这些能力并不普遍:较弱的模型
仍然依赖近近的捷径,在某些情况下甚至可能恶化
跟踪修复过程中的性能。 总之,这些事实表明,
目前,VLM在单元格跟踪中被更好的用作推理模块
而不是作为专门追踪器的替代品。 我们期待我们
CellTrack-Bench作为开发能对复杂的生物事件进行认知推理的VLM的评价设置,专业的跟踪者经常在其中犯错误.

blocks.en:
Models are invoked through their native multimodal interface and, when tools
are available, their native tool-call representation. The harness maps tool
calls to the same deterministic server-side crop operation and normalizes only
the final answer to the common task representation used for scoring. We draw
one completion for every instance, task, and condition. Parallel dispatch can
change execution order but not prompts, predictions, or scores.

妇女可以使用自己的工具。 绘图工具

blocks.en:
Before a complete sweep, a fixed ten-instance smoke set spanning datasets
checks prompt completeness, image rendering, native tool execution, final
answer parsing, and scorer coverage for every task and condition. A complete
sweep is invalidated by missing calls, terminal-answer truncation,
output-budget exhaustion, tool-loop failure, or provenance mismatch. API
request failures are retried at most five times under a fixed policy and never
according to answer quality.

blocks.en:
Each request receives 8,192 output tokens shared by reasoning and tool turns,
with 2,048 tokens reserved for the final structured answer. If an inspection
turn reaches its cap, tools are withdrawn and the reserved answer turn is
invoked. Individual malformed answers remain model outcomes and receive the
score implied by their parsed or empty prediction; JSON and schema failures are
reported per condition. The selection sweep produced no schema failures,
terminal truncations, budget exhaustions, safety-cap hits, or tool failures.

blocks.en:
The primary score for linking is F1 over ( source , target , semantic ) (\mathrm{source},\mathrm{target},\mathrm{semantic}) edge tuples. Repair
uses the same score after applying the predicted operations to the HOCT
proposal, and inspection uses F1 over review decisions. NN-residual F1 removes
links explained by nearest-centroid matching. Division F1 applies the semantic
edge score to division links, exposing performance on the infrequent branch
class without replacing the primary score.

班级没有替换主分数。
